name: Beta
description: Beta channel of the Gallery plugin: disk-backed media browsing, the media viewer and workflow/caption inspection under its own /beta API prefix, so it can be installed alongside the stable Gallery. Also serves as the boilerplate for future beta plugin channels.
author: LainStable

volumes.description: Media root that this beta gallery browses (media, captions and metadata are read directly from here).

assistant_actions.name: scan_status
assistant_actions.description: Report beta gallery status for the configured media root (root, mount state, media counts).

assistant_actions.name: rescan_library
assistant_actions.description: Rescan the beta gallery library so new or removed media shows up.
